annotations.title: Agents moving a tokenized stock, over a window

description: How many AI agents moved a tokenized stock over a window you choose (default the last 24 hours): distinct agent addresses, transfers in and out, value at the issuer’s reference, by token and network. Ask by ticker (TSLA), company name (Tesla) or ISIN, or leave it empty for every stock. Free. Agents are the addresses we hold as ERC-8004 owners, ACP providers and clients, Olas task agents and x402 payees; read on Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain; issuer wallets are left out.

chain.description: One network: base, arbitrum, bnb or robinhood.

hours.description: The window in hours (default 24, up to 31 days).

q.description: A ticker, company name or ISIN; omit for every stock.

name: stock_agent_activity

agents.description: Distinct agent addresses that moved it.

coverage.description: What is read and what is not.

matched.description: Whether the question matched a stock.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
